paper_title: Constraints on Axion-like Particles from a Hard $X$-ray Observation of Betelgeuse
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (lower/optimistic boundary of red exclusion band)
notes: Astrophysical bound from NuSTAR hard X-ray observation of Betelgeuse. ALPs produced via Primakoff in stellar core convert in Galactic magnetic field. 95% C.L. limit g_agamma < (0.5-1.8)e-11 GeV^-1 for m_a < (5.5-3.5)e-11 eV. The limit is essentially flat (mass-independent) up to a cutoff mass. Most conservative limit 1.8e-11 GeV^-1 (BT=0.4uG) valid for m_a < 3.5e-11 eV; most optimistic 5.2e-12 GeV^-1 (BT=3uG) for m_a<5.5e-11 eV. Encoded here the conservative flat bound; the low-mass end extends to very low masses.
